capabilities: Render images in predefined layout blocks via fenced code blocks
Add captions and overlay text to layout images
Build galleries from a vault folder and scrollable carousels
Define custom layouts by drawing grids in ASCII art
Show placeholders when a layout has too few images
extras: Author calls it a first attempt that is rough around the edges; full block options and layout docs live on external documentation pages; legacy layouts from version 0.10.0 and earlier remain supported.
motivation: The author wanted to lay images out beautifully in notes and to visually tell stories in image-heavy notes.
problem: Obsidian embeds images one at a time with no way to arrange several of them in a visually pleasing layout within a note.
summary: Renders groups of images in styled layouts (grids, masonry, carousels) inside notes via fenced code blocks like ```image-layout-a.
